New: answer several questions at once from the notch, each agent's prompt kept on its own, and no more rows stuck on "Needs you". Quit and reopen AI Notch after upgrading.

What's new

- Questions from the notch: a prompt with up to four questions, ones that take several picks included, is answered right in the notch. Each question lists its options as toggles, and Submit works once every question has an answer. One plain question is still a single click. A typed answer (Other) is still given in the editor, which keeps its own prompt up; whichever you answer first counts.
- Each agent's prompt on its own: when the main chat and a subagent wait at the same time, answering one no longer ends the other's wait or removes its prompt. The card shows one prompt and how many more are waiting, and a subagent's question is named with its type. The keyboard shortcuts never answer a question.

Fixes

- Rows stuck on "Needs you": when a subagent stops running, its prompt goes with it, so a row no longer says "Needs you" with nothing to answer.

After upgrading

- Quit and reopen AI Notch. An older copy that is still running shows only the first of several questions.

Install or upgrade:

    brew install --cask ankeshshankar/tap/ai-notch
    brew upgrade --cask ai-notch

First open: the app is signed ad hoc and not notarized, so macOS blocks it once. Open AI Notch, then in System Settings → Privacy & Security click Open Anyway and confirm with your password. If Set Up then reports the helper is blocked, run the command it shows:

    xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/AINotch.app

Requires macOS 15 or later.
